name: Local Markdown Notes Manager
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a simple single-user desktop application with local SQLite and Electron.

requirements_model.project_scope: A lightweight desktop application for composing, tagging, and organizing local Markdown notes without cloud synchronization.

target_users_and_actors.name: Note Author
target_users_and_actors.description: Primary user creating, editing, categorizing, and searching Markdown text notes.

functional_requirements.title: Note Creation & Editing
functional_requirements.description: Allow author to compose and edit notes using standard GitHub Flavored Markdown syntax with live preview.
acceptance_criteria: Edits autosave within 500ms of inactivity.
Syntax preview updates concurrently without UI freezing.

functional_requirements.title: Full-Text Search using SQLite FTS5
functional_requirements.description: Provide indexed search across note titles, bodies, and tags using SQLite FTS5 virtual table.
acceptance_criteria: Search queries return results in under 50ms for libraries up to 10,000 notes.

non_functional_requirements.description: Application launch time must be under 1.5 seconds on standard desktop hardware.
Keyboard shortcuts for all core operations (new note, search, save, switch view).

system_constraints: SQLite with FTS5 for local search index
assumptions_and_dependencies: User has read/write permissions to user documents folder

name: Git Commit Hook Linter & Changelog Generator
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a developer CLI utility that enforces conventional commits and compiles changelogs.

requirements_model.project_scope: A zero-dependency CLI tool installed as a Git pre-commit hook to parse diffs, validate conventional commit formatting, and build changelogs.

target_users_and_actors.name: Software Developer
target_users_and_actors.description: Author committing code changes to a Git repository.

target_users_and_actors.name: Git CLI
target_users_and_actors.description: External version control system invoking hooks.

functional_requirements.title: Conventional Commit Verification
functional_requirements.description: Inspect commit messages against regex rules (feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor) before git finishes commit creation.
acceptance_criteria: Rejects invalid messages with descriptive error in stderr.
Valid commits exit with status 0 in < 30ms.

functional_requirements.title: Automated SemVer Changelog Compilation
functional_requirements.description: Extract committed tags and group commits into CHANGELOG.md during release command.
acceptance_criteria: Generates markdown file formatted per Keep a Changelog standards.

non_functional_requirements.description: Execution latency must not delay git workflows.

system_constraints: Rust or Go single binary distribution

name: Static Asset Compression & S3 Sync Daemon
description: Evaluates diagram planning for an asset optimization daemon monitoring local directories and synchronizing to AWS S3.

requirements_model.project_scope: A background service monitoring a designated assets directory, converting images to WebP/AVIF, compressing text assets with Brotli, and uploading to Amazon S3 with immutable cache headers.

target_users_and_actors.name: Site Administrator
target_users_and_actors.description: Configures watcher paths, compression levels, and S3 bucket credentials.

target_users_and_actors.name: Amazon S3
target_users_and_actors.description: Target object store for optimized static assets.

functional_requirements.title: Directory File System Watcher
functional_requirements.description: Watch designated folder for file creation or modification events using inotify/ReadDirectoryChanges.
acceptance_criteria: Debounces rapid write events by 200ms before triggering processing.

functional_requirements.title: Compression Pipeline & S3 Upload
functional_requirements.description: Compress images and upload to S3 if checksum differs from remote ETag.
acceptance_criteria: Sets Cache-Control max-age=31536000 on uploaded objects.
Retries failed S3 uploads with exponential backoff up to 3 times.

non_functional_requirements.description: Daemon must survive network disconnects gracefully.

system_constraints: AWS S3 SDK for multipart uploads
assumptions_and_dependencies: Valid AWS credentials provided via environment or IAM role

name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Checkout & Inventory Lock
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a distributed checkout system with Redis locking, Stripe payments, and PostgreSQL.

requirements_model.project_scope: A high-concurrency checkout and order placement engine managing multi-vendor shopping carts, distributed stock locking, and payment orchestration.

target_users_and_actors.name: Customer
target_users_and_actors.description: Shopper reviewing cart, entering shipping details, and paying for order.

target_users_and_actors.name: Stripe Gateway
target_users_and_actors.description: External payment processor handling credit card transactions and 3D Secure verification.

target_users_and_actors.name: Kafka Event Bus
target_users_and_actors.description: Message broker distributing OrderCreated events to warehouse microservices.

functional_requirements.title: Optimistic Inventory Reservation
functional_requirements.description: Reserve stock in Redis with a 10-minute TTL when user initiates checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Locks stock using Redis Redlock algorithm.
Releases stock automatically if payment not completed within 10 minutes.

functional_requirements.title: Payment Processing & Order Finalization
functional_requirements.description: Confirm Stripe PaymentIntent, record permanent order in PostgreSQL, and publish OrderCreated event.
acceptance_criteria: Guarantees exactly-once order insertion using idempotent transaction tokens.

non_functional_requirements.description: Handle peak flash sale checkout traffic without overselling.
PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance; no raw credit card data stored locally.

name: Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard & Canvas
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a collaborative whiteboard utilizing WebSockets, CRDT synchronization, and snapshot storage.

requirements_model.project_scope: A collaborative virtual canvas allowing multiple users to draw shapes, add sticky notes, and edit diagrams concurrently with sub-50ms peer synchronization.

target_users_and_actors.name: Board Collaborator
target_users_and_actors.description: Team member drawing shapes, typing text, and moving canvas objects.

target_users_and_actors.name: WebSocket Server
target_users_and_actors.description: Relay node broadcasting CRDT document updates and presence cursors.

functional_requirements.title: Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) Synchronization
functional_requirements.description: Propagate canvas delta operations using Yjs or Automerge over WebSocket channels.
acceptance_criteria: All connected clients converge to the exact same canvas state without merge conflicts.

functional_requirements.title: Live Presence & Cursor Tracking
functional_requirements.description: Stream collaborator cursor coordinates and active selection bounding boxes at 30 FPS.
acceptance_criteria: Cursor latency under 40ms on standard broadband connections.

non_functional_requirements.description: Canvas rendering must maintain smooth 60 FPS under 1,000 active objects.

system_constraints: Node.js WebSocket cluster with Redis Pub/Sub
assumptions_and_dependencies: Clients have modern browsers supporting WebSockets and WebGL

name: HIPAA-Compliant Patient Portal & Video Consultations
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a secure telehealth portal with WebRTC video signaling, EHR database, and audit log.

requirements_model.project_scope: A HIPAA-compliant web portal connecting verified medical practitioners and patients via encrypted WebRTC video visits and Electronic Health Record (EHR) management.

target_users_and_actors.name: Patient
target_users_and_actors.description: Individual scheduling appointments, joining video calls, and reviewing prescriptions.

target_users_and_actors.name: Doctor
target_users_and_actors.description: Licensed clinician conducting video consultations and entering medical encounter notes.

target_users_and_actors.name: HIPAA Audit Service
target_users_and_actors.description: Tamper-evident service recording every access to Protected Health Information (PHI).

functional_requirements.title: Encrypted WebRTC Video Consultation
functional_requirements.description: Establish peer-to-peer audio/video connection using STUN/TURN signaling with end-to-end DTLS-SRTP encryption.
acceptance_criteria: Signaling completes within 3 seconds of both parties entering the virtual room.
Video stream encrypted with AES-128 minimum.

functional_requirements.title: EHR Access Control & Audit Trail
functional_requirements.description: Restrict record visibility to assigned medical staff and log all access events with cryptographic checksums.
acceptance_criteria: All PHI reads/writes generate an immutable audit log entry in PostgreSQL within 100ms.

non_functional_requirements.description: HIPAA Security Rule compliance; encryption at rest and in transit.
non_functional_requirements.metric: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit

system_constraints: PostgreSQL with pgcrypto for encrypted columns
WORM (Write Once Read Many) compliant storage for audit records
assumptions_and_dependencies: TURN servers deployed across multiple geographical zones

name: Smart Grid Telemetry Ingestion & Anomaly Alert Engine
description: Evaluates diagram planning for an IoT telemetry system ingesting meter data over MQTT with timeseries alerting.

requirements_model.project_scope: An enterprise telemetry ingestion and real-time anomaly detection system monitoring electric grid meters, frequency fluctuations, and substation transformers.

target_users_and_actors.name: Smart Meter Device
target_users_and_actors.description: Hardware sensor transmitting power, voltage, and temperature metrics over MQTT.

target_users_and_actors.name: Grid Dispatch Operator
target_users_and_actors.description: Monitors dashboard alerts and approves emergency load shedding protocols.

functional_requirements.title: MQTT Telemetry Packet Ingestion
functional_requirements.description: Ingest JSON-encoded telemetry packets via EMQX broker and buffer into TimescaleDB.
acceptance_criteria: Processes up to 50,000 metrics per second with p99 ingestion delay < 200ms.

functional_requirements.title: Voltage Spike Anomaly Detection
functional_requirements.description: Evaluate rolling 1-minute window across meter readings; fire alert when variance exceeds 15% nominal voltage.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches alert push notification to operator console within 1 second of threshold breach.

non_functional_requirements.description: Zero data loss during broker failover.

system_constraints: Go worker daemon for anomaly calculations
assumptions_and_dependencies: Cellular NB-IoT / LTE-M network connectivity on smart meters

name: Peer-to-Peer Instant Payment & Ledger Settlement
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a financial transfer platform with double-entry accounting, fraud check, and 2FA.

requirements_model.project_scope: A real-time financial ledger and peer-to-peer transfer platform with double-entry accounting, risk engine screening, and two-factor authentication.

target_users_and_actors.name: Sender
target_users_and_actors.description: Account holder sending funds to a recipient.

target_users_and_actors.name: Recipient
target_users_and_actors.description: Account holder receiving credited funds.

target_users_and_actors.name: Fraud Detection Engine
target_users_and_actors.description: Machine learning scoring service rating transaction risk from 0 to 100.

target_users_and_actors.name: SMS Gateway
target_users_and_actors.description: Provider sending one-time passcodes (OTP) for high-risk transfers.

functional_requirements.title: Double-Entry Ledger Transfer
functional_requirements.description: Debit sender account balance and credit recipient account balance within a single ACID transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Sum of debits must strictly equal sum of credits for every transaction.
Rejects transfer if sender balance is insufficient.

functional_requirements.title: Fraud Risk Evaluation & Step-Up 2FA
functional_requirements.description: Evaluate transfer risk score; if score > 70, trigger SMS OTP challenge before debiting.
acceptance_criteria: OTP expires in 3 minutes.
Blocks transfer after 3 failed OTP attempts.

non_functional_requirements.description: Strict idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transfers.

system_constraints: PostgreSQL with strict serializable isolation level

name: Autonomous Drone Fleet Teleoperation & Route Dispatcher
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a complex drone fleet dispatcher with telemetry streams, geofencing, and flight state machines.

requirements_model.project_scope: A mission-critical teleoperation and autonomous flight coordination platform managing fleets of delivery drones with live 4G/5G telemetry, dynamic 3D geofencing, and emergency failover protocols.

target_users_and_actors.name: Flight Director
target_users_and_actors.description: Human operator in Ground Control Station authorizing flight plans and manual overrides.

target_users_and_actors.name: Autonomous Drone
target_users_and_actors.description: Unmanned aerial vehicle executing onboard waypoint navigation and reporting sensor telemetry.

target_users_and_actors.name: Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) API
target_users_and_actors.description: External government airspace authority providing live temporary flight restrictions (TFR).

functional_requirements.title: Real-Time Telemetry & Heartbeat Ingestion
functional_requirements.description: Stream 20Hz GPS, battery, altitude, and IMU data from drones over WebSockets/gRPC.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers Return-to-Home (RTH) autonomous failover if telemetry heartbeat is lost for > 5 seconds.

functional_requirements.title: Dynamic 3D Geofence Violation Prevention
functional_requirements.description: Continuously intersect planned drone trajectory with airspace restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: Halts forward motion and enters hover state if distance to forbidden boundary < 50 meters.

non_functional_requirements.description: Mission control failover must maintain continuous command uplink.
Emergency stop or RTH command propagation latency.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Latency < 100ms from operator click to drone acknowledge

system_constraints: Redis cluster for geospatial telemetry index
PostGIS database for 3D polygon geofence definitions
assumptions_and_dependencies: Drones equipped with RTK GPS and 5G cellular modems

name: Distributed Adaptive Bitrate Video Transcoding Mesh
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a media transcoding system with S3 upload, RabbitMQ, GPU FFmpeg workers, and HLS manifest generation.

requirements_model.project_scope: A cloud-native distributed video transcoding pipeline processing raw 4K video uploads into multi-bitrate HLS and DASH streams using GPU-accelerated worker pools.

target_users_and_actors.name: Content Creator
target_users_and_actors.description: User uploading raw master video files via pre-signed multipart URLs.

target_users_and_actors.name: Orchestrator Service
target_users_and_actors.description: Splits master videos into 10-second segments and schedules distributed FFmpeg worker tasks.

target_users_and_actors.name: FFmpeg GPU Worker
target_users_and_actors.description: Stateless worker node pulling chunk jobs from queue and encoding into H.264/HEVC/AV1.

target_users_and_actors.name: CloudFront CDN
target_users_and_actors.description: Global edge caching delivering finalized HLS playlists to consumer video players.

functional_requirements.title: Parallel Segment Splitting & Queue Dispatch
functional_requirements.description: Decompose incoming master video into keyframe-aligned TS segments and publish encoding tasks to RabbitMQ.
acceptance_criteria: Splits 1-hour 4K file in under 90 seconds without audio desynchronization.

functional_requirements.title: Manifest Stitching & Multi-Bitrate Packaging
functional_requirements.description: Aggregate encoded chunks into master.m3u8 playlist with 1080p, 720p, 480p, and 360p renditions.
acceptance_criteria: Validates manifest against Apple HLS specification before publishing to S3.

non_functional_requirements.description: Auto-scale worker fleet from 2 to 200 nodes based on queue depth.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Queue processing latency < 5 minutes for 15-minute video

system_constraints: RabbitMQ message broker with priority queues
Amazon S3 bucket storage with CloudFront CDN
assumptions_and_dependencies: AWS GPU instances (g4dn / g5) available in deployment region

name: Zero-Trust Service Mesh & Secret Rotation Orchestrator
description: Evaluates diagram planning for an enterprise zero-trust Kubernetes mesh with Envoy sidecars, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and HashiCorp Vault.

requirements_model.project_scope: An enterprise Kubernetes security orchestrator enforcing strict zero-trust network architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), cryptographically verifiable SPIFFE identities, and automated dynamic secret rotation.

target_users_and_actors.name: Microservice Workload
target_users_and_actors.description: Containerized application communicating with other services strictly through Envoy sidecars.

target_users_and_actors.name: SPIRE Server
target_users_and_actors.description: Workload attestation authority issuing short-lived X.509 SVID certificates.

target_users_and_actors.name: HashiCorp Vault
target_users_and_actors.description: Enterprise secret management vault generating dynamic database credentials and signing keys.

target_users_and_actors.name: SecOps Auditor
target_users_and_actors.description: Security engineer monitoring policy enforcement and audit trails.

functional_requirements.title: Automated mTLS Handshake & SPIFFE Attestation
functional_requirements.description: Intercept all pod egress and ingress traffic; require valid X.509 SVID with SAN matching peer authorization policy.
acceptance_criteria: Terminates connections from non-attested workloads with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
mTLS handshake overhead < 2ms.

functional_requirements.title: Zero-Downtime Dynamic Secret Rotation
functional_requirements.description: Rotate database credentials and certificates every 60 minutes without restarting application pods.
acceptance_criteria: Envoy reloads certificates via Secret Discovery Service (SDS) with 0 dropped connections.

non_functional_requirements.description: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 cryptographic modules for key storage.
non_functional_requirements.metric: 100% keys backed by HSM or KMS

assumptions_and_dependencies: Kubernetes API server supports admission webhooks

name: Order Book Matching Engine & FIX Protocol Gateway
description: Evaluates diagram planning for a low-latency exchange matching engine using LMAX Disruptor, FIX 4.4, and market data feeds.

requirements_model.project_scope: A financial exchange matching engine processing limit and market orders using a lock-free ring buffer architecture, FIX 4.4 gateway, and deterministic order priority.

target_users_and_actors.name: Institutional Trader
target_users_and_actors.description: High-frequency trading desk sending orders and receiving execution reports over FIX.

target_users_and_actors.name: FIX Gateway
target_users_and_actors.description: Low-latency network gateway parsing incoming FIX 4.4 messages and enforcing pre-trade risk checks.

target_users_and_actors.name: Order Book Core
target_users_and_actors.description: In-memory price-time priority matching engine executing orders against the book.

target_users_and_actors.name: Market Data Multicast Feed
target_users_and_actors.description: UDP multicast feed publishing top-of-book and trade prints.

functional_requirements.title: Deterministic Price-Time Priority Matching
functional_requirements.description: Match bids and asks in-memory; generate immediate execution reports and update resting limit order queues.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministically processes orders in sequence of arrival timestamp.
Sub-microsecond matching latency (p99 < 850ns).

functional_requirements.title: Drop-Copy & Snapshot Journaling
functional_requirements.description: Persist all matched trades to non-volatile memory and replicate to drop-copy regulatory clearing gateway.
acceptance_criteria: Zero state loss in event of hardware crash; recover book state from journal in < 5 seconds.

non_functional_requirements.description: Sustain peak bursts of 500,000 orders/sec without garbage collection pauses.

system_constraints: C++20 or Java with LMAX Disruptor
assumptions_and_dependencies: Dedicated bare-metal server cluster with core pinning and disabled CPU frequency scaling

name: Ultra-Dense Global Cloud Telecommunication Mesh
description: Evaluates diagram planning for an extreme-scale telecommunications mesh with 12 distinct microservices, demanding strict typology mapping and zero dropped boundaries.

requirements_model.project_scope: A carrier-grade 5G Core (5GC) control plane and voice orchestration platform providing SIP session routing, Diameter/HTTP2 policy charging (PCF), Call Detail Record (CDR) ingestion, and multi-region Cassandra persistence.

target_users_and_actors.name: Media Gateway (UPF)

target_users_and_actors.name: Policy Charging Function (PCF)
